Finding submitted.

**Result: `missing` (fallback-level cure inserted)**

- **Investigation:** Section 11 (Term/Termination), Section 12 (Source Code Escrow), and full-document searches for transition/data/return/export language. Section 11.3 only lists surviving sections, preserves Corio's then-existing Customer licence and Commerce One's support obligation (conditioned on continued payment), and requires mutual return/destruction of Confidential Information. Section 12 releases Source Code only on narrow Release Conditions — neither is an exit or data-return right. No "Customer Data" definition exists.
- **Redline:** new Section 11.4 inserted after p0098 — at least 90 days of transition assistance on any expiration or termination, plus export and delivery within 30 days of all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Corio or its Customers (drafted broadly rather than to named examples).
- **Level choice:** fallback, as the shortest complete cure; then-current-rates, machine-readable format and certified-deletion wording were not volunteered.
